title: Cohort
description: A set of patient/study selection criteria plus the sources to draw from. Resolution (the frozen list of patient/study references that match the criteria at a point in time) lives in a separate CohortResolution document, not here — Cohort holds intent, Resolution holds the snapshot.

description.description: Markdown description of the cohort: research question, inclusion/exclusion intent, references.

sources.description: Where to draw studies from. Order is meaningful for CONSORT bookkeeping (priority 1, 2, …).

kind.description: idc-query: BigQuery-style filter against the IDC catalog. dicomweb: a DICOMweb root URL with optional query params. local-uri: a Manila/Swift/file URI on the LNQ-data share.

description.description: Optional human-readable note: why this source, who curated it, when.

consort.description: CONSORT-diagram bookkeeping. Optional on the cohort definition; the resolver may emit a more detailed CONSORT in the CohortResolution.
